timing: Post-search diagnostic, frozen after the 512-candidate scan; does not change its steps, refinement budget or selection
selection: All order/rank-passing candidates with certified symmetric gap lower > 1/5
conditioning: Check inherited exact intrinsic moment and condition gates for all selected candidates
statistic: Maximum over the 90 individual Poisson interval counts of a certified squared-Hellinger lower bound on total variation
exponent: Exact pi/square-root intervals; exponent lower capped at 1 before the inherited alternating series
decision: TV lower > 1/4 certifies incompatibility with the close-law gate; smaller lower bounds are inconclusive
stop: One analytical marginal pass; no classifier, extra geometry or Monte Carlo samples
